n25d1046653.headline: Annual revenues at acquisitive Nutella maker Ferrero jump 21%
n25d1046653.summary: Revenues at Ferrero rose 21% to 17 billion euros in the fiscal year ended August 2023. Growth was boosted by organic expansion and acquisitions, the family-owned Italian food group said.
n25d1046653.why: Ferrero is a privately held Italian confectionery group known for Nutella, and its acquisitions reshape competition in global packaged food.

n04f0b61f06.headline: New Zealand Oil & Gas increases stake in Mereenie field
n04f0b61f06.summary: New Zealand Oil & Gas has increased its stake in the Mereenie field by acquiring an additional 25% equity interest. The field is located in Australia's Northern Territory.
n04f0b61f06.why: New Zealand Oil & Gas is a listed upstream energy company with interests in Australian gas fields, which supply domestic and export markets.

n95e17a0fd2.headline: Load shedding in South Africa: From 2007 to it's 'not the end of the world'
n95e17a0fd2.summary: According to EskomSePush data, South Africans endured a record 332 days of load shedding in 2023. The power cuts remain a significant drag on the economy.
n95e17a0fd2.why: Eskom is South Africa's state-owned electricity utility, and recurring power cuts weigh on industrial output, investment and growth in Africa's second-largest economy.

n4498f91fcb.headline: Parsons Reports Record Results Since IPO for the Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2023
n4498f91fcb.summary: Parsons reported fourth-quarter revenue of $1.5 billion, up 35% year over year, with organic growth of 34% and at least 20% organic growth in both segments.
n4498f91fcb.why: Parsons is a US defense and intelligence technology contractor, so its results reflect government and defense spending demand.

n5999bd71d2.headline: B.Grimm Power Signs MOU with National Energy Technology Center
n5999bd71d2.summary: B.Grimm Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with the National Energy Technology Center to foster renewable energy innovation and sustainable development. The agreement is non-binding according to the input.
n5999bd71d2.why: B.Grimm Power is a Thai independent power producer, and its renewable projects matter for the country's energy transition.

naa2093e004.headline: Wabtec Reports Strong Fourth Quarter 2023 Results; Issues 2024 Full-Year Guidance
naa2093e004.summary: Wabtec reported GAAP earnings per share of $1.20, up 39.5%, and adjusted EPS of $1.54, up 18.5%, on sales growth of 9.5%. The company also issued full-year 2024 guidance.
naa2093e004.why: Wabtec makes locomotives and rail equipment, so its orders and guidance signal the health of rail and freight investment.

nafb7efd054.headline: Egypt, EU Discuss Applying CBAM To Advance Green Transition
nafb7efd054.summary: Egypt's environment minister said Egypt wants closer cooperation with the EU on applying the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism. The aim is to advance its green transition.
nafb7efd054.why: The EU's CBAM imposes carbon costs on imports such as steel and cement, affecting exporters in non-EU countries.

ne24994a396.headline: Inflation's Grip: The Struggle of Iranian Households
ne24994a396.summary: Iran's inflation rate has surged past 40% over the past four years. Basic necessities such as housing, cars and groceries are increasingly out of reach for many households.
ne24994a396.why: Persistent high inflation erodes purchasing power and signals macroeconomic stress that affects investment and currency stability.

nfc027e75ba.headline: Budget 2024: Beer association calls for sin tax increase in line with projected inflation
nfc027e75ba.summary: The Beer Association of South Africa called for a sin tax increase in line with projected inflation ahead of the 2024 Budget Speech. The request targets excise duties on alcohol.
nfc027e75ba.why: Excise duties on alcohol are a source of government revenue in South Africa, and changes affect brewers' costs and pricing.

n21e44a53dd.headline: Bakers To Begin Nationwide Strike Feb 27 Over Production Cost Inflation
n21e44a53dd.summary: The Association of Master Bakers and Caterers of Nigeria issued a nationwide strike notice from February 27, citing an unfavourable business climate and production cost inflation.
n21e44a53dd.why: Strikes in food production affect bread supply and input costs for Nigerian consumers and businesses, linking labour action to inflation.

n622313fcf4.headline: Raisio CEO Pekka Kuusniemi to leave the company
n622313fcf4.summary: Raisio has started searching for a new chief executive, with Pekka Kuusniemi expected to officially leave the company in June.
n622313fcf4.why: Raisio is a Finnish food and ingredients company, and leadership changes can affect strategy and investor confidence.

naaa401974f.headline: TotalEnergies CEO says IMF debt rules hobbling African green energy projects
naaa401974f.summary: TotalEnergies' CEO said renewable energy investment in Africa is being hobbled by insufficient government loan guarantees, as the IMF keeps a tight leash on country indebtedness.
naaa401974f.why: TotalEnergies is a major French energy company with growing renewable operations, so funding conditions for African projects affect its investment plans.

nb32d0c401f.headline: Restrictions on Canadian student visas may redirect Bangladeshi students to Russia and China
nb32d0c401f.summary: Canada reported a 35 percent reduction in visas for international undergraduate students for 2024 and 2025 and raised the cost-of-living requirement from C$10,000 to C$20,635. Bangladeshi students may be redirected to Russia and China.
nb32d0c401f.why: International students are a significant revenue source for Canadian universities and colleges, so visa policy changes affect the education sector and related local economies.

n22943503b1.summary: Bayer is increasing its investment in radiopharmaceuticals, a cancer-targeting approach, and is working with PanTera, a supplier of starting materials for next-generation products.
n22943503b1.why: Bayer is a large German pharmaceutical and crop science group, and radiopharmaceuticals are a growing oncology segment.

n08b7c3deec.headline: Egypt targets $US5.6 billion in revenues from IPO by the end of 2024
n08b7c3deec.summary: Egyptian Finance Minister Mohamed Maait said the government IPO programme aims to raise up to US$5.6 billion by the end of 2024, enhancing the country's ability to meet financing needs.

n1469927a00.headline: Treasury eyes 'rare' full employment opportunity
n1469927a00.summary: Australia's Treasury sees a rare opportunity for full employment, as no evidence of a wage-price spiral suggests the jobless rate can stay lower than previously thought sustainable.
n1469927a00.why: Unemployment and wage trends shape central bank interest-rate decisions, which feed through to bond yields, the currency and equity valuations.

n4a86566194.headline: EdiliziAcrobatica, revenues grow in 2023 thanks to diversification
n4a86566194.summary: EdiliziAcrobatica reported total revenues of EUR164.4 million for 2023, up 11 percent from EUR148.1 million the previous year. The company attributed growth to diversification.
n4a86566194.why: EdiliziAcrobatica is an Italian construction and building services company, and its results indicate activity in the Italian building sector.

n8712a26b0b.headline: Transaction Capital’s WeBuyCars gears up for a separate listing on JSE

n91b5327e68.headline: Bui Sells Power To ECG In Dollars … Instead of Cedis – PAC told
n91b5327e68.summary: The Bui Power Authority settles power sales to the Electricity Company of Ghana in US dollars rather than cedis, Parliament's Public Accounts Committee was told.

n9240f9a8fb.headline: GBP/USD Forecast: UK Inflation Steadies, US Inflation Rises
n9240f9a8fb.summary: The pound dipped following figures showing stable UK inflation for January, while US inflation rose, according to a Forex Crunch forecast.

n6dc2fd854c.headline: Foreign tourists to Bali to pay $10 entry tax from Valentine's Day

n6dc2fd854c.why: Tourism is a major source of foreign income for Bali and Indonesia, so visitor charges can affect hotel demand and the local economy.

n970f0f0f00.headline: Average UK house price dipped by £4,000 over year to December 2023 – ONS
n970f0f0f00.summary: The Office for National Statistics reports that the average UK house price dipped by £4,000 over the year to December 2023. Annual private rental price growth stayed at a record high.
n970f0f0f00.why: The ONS publishes the UK's official house price and rental data, which feed into mortgage markets, interest-rate expectations, and housing-sector equities.

nb62f89bc5b.headline: US, EU discuss Russia sanctions ahead of Ukraine war's second anniversary
nb62f89bc5b.summary: The U.S., EU and other partners discussed Russia sanctions at a meeting in Brussels ahead of the two-year anniversary of the war in Ukraine. The talks were reported by MarketScreener.
nb62f89bc5b.why: Sanctions on Russia restrict its access to Western finance, energy markets and technology, affecting global commodity flows and corporate exposure.

n6ac97d222d.headline: Tinubu Seeks Senate Confirmation For Five CBN Board Directors
n6ac97d222d.summary: President Bola Tinubu asked the Senate to confirm the appointment of five persons as directors of the Central Bank of Nigeria board.
n6ac97d222d.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria sets monetary policy for Africa's largest economy by GDP, so its board composition shapes naira and interest-rate policy.

n8ce5cebb84.headline: French wheat stocks forecast raised again on waning EU demand

n8ce5cebb84.why: France is a major EU grain producer and exporter, so its wheat stocks and export flows influence European and global grain prices.

n5faa9c021a.headline: FOREX 3-Dollar rises as hot U.S. inflation cools Fed rate cut bets
n5faa9c021a.summary: The dollar rose to a fresh three-month high against major peers as traders pushed back bets on a Federal Reserve rate cut after surprisingly hot US inflation figures.
n5faa9c021a.why: US inflation data guides Federal Reserve policy, and rate expectations drive the dollar's value against other major currencies.

n178629e21a.summary: U.S. Treasury yields eased on Wednesday as investors digested the latest inflation data. They considered what the data could mean for interest rates.
n178629e21a.why: Treasury yields set the benchmark cost of US government borrowing and influence rates across the economy. Inflation data shapes expectations for Federal Reserve policy.

nbf3089409a.summary: The euro-dollar pair slumped again after an upbeat US consumer price index release, trading around the 1.0700 psychological level.
